name: Impulse Compaction

tasks.description: Refactor renegotiateContext to load all impulses internally

prompt.template:
Refactor SessionMemoryAgent.renegotiateContext() to use impulse-only approach.

## Current State

The function currently accepts messages array and messageImpulses/otherImpulses arrays. This split makes unified token accounting impossible.

## Target State

Function should:
1. Accept only sessionID and model info
2. Load ALL impulses internally via SessionMemory.listImpulses()
3. Categorize impulses: turn impulses vs context impulses
4. Calculate current tokens from loaded impulses only
5. Use LLM to decide what to keep/unload/delete
6. Return same decision structure (backward compatible)

## Implementation

In src/session/memory-agent.ts:

1. **Update function signature**:
```typescript
export async function renegotiateContext(input: {
  sessionID: string
  model: { providerID: string; modelID: string }
})
```

2. **Load all impulses**:
```typescript
const allImpulses = await SessionMemory.listImpulses(input.sessionID)
const turnImpulses = allImpulses.filter(i => i.type === "messageHistory")
const contextImpulses = allImpulses.filter(i => i.type !== "messageHistory")
```

3. **Calculate tokens from loaded impulses**:
```typescript
const currentTokens = allImpulses
  .filter(i => i.loaded)
  .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.tokenCount || 0), 0)
```

4. **Calculate target tokens**:
```typescript
const model = await Provider.getModel(input.model.providerID, input.model.modelID)
const outputTokens = Math.min(model.info.limit.output, 8000)
const usableContext = model.info.limit.context - outputTokens
const targetTokens = Math.floor(usableContext * 0.6) // 60% threshold
```

5. **Update system prompt** to show impulse categories and token accounting

6. **Return same structure** for backward compatibility

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Function signature simplified (no messages parameter)
- [ ] Loads all impulses internally
- [ ] Token calculation from loaded impulses
- [ ] System prompt updated with impulse breakdown
- [ ] Returns backward-compatible decision structure
- [ ] No compilation errors
- [ ] Existing tests still pass

tasks.description: Update SessionCompaction.renegotiate() to use new impulse-only interface

prompt.template:
Update SessionCompaction.renegotiate() to call the new impulse-only renegotiateContext().

## Changes Needed

In src/session/compaction.ts:

1. **Remove message loading** (lines ~113-139)
   - Delete message fetching logic
   - Delete token calculation from messages

2. **Simplify renegotiation call**:
```typescript
const decision = await SessionMemoryAgent.renegotiateContext({
  sessionID: input.sessionID,
  model: {
    providerID: input.providerID,
    modelID: input.modelID,
  },
})
```

3. **Execute impulse decisions**:
```typescript
// Unload impulses
for (const impulseID of decision.impulsesToUnload) {
  await SessionMemory.updateImpulse(input.sessionID, impulseID, {
    loaded: false,
    content: undefined,
  })
}

// Delete impulses
for (const impulseID of decision.impulsesToDelete) {
  await SessionMemory.removeImpulse(input.sessionID, impulseID)
}
```

4. **Remove old message compaction logic** (lines ~169-181)
   - Delete messagesToRemove handling
   - Delete messagesToCompress handling

5. **Keep summary message creation** for user notification

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Removes message loading code
- [ ] Simplified renegotiation call
- [ ] Executes impulse unload/delete decisions
- [ ] Removes old message compaction logic
- [ ] Keeps user notification message
- [ ] No compilation errors
